sub_graphs.title: Cancun LOG Instructions: Gas Cost Calculation
sub_graphs.description: Models the multi-component gas cost calculation for LOG opcodes

nodes.label: LOG Gas Calculation Started
nodes.description: Beginning gas calculation for LOG instruction

nodes.label: Charge Base LOG Gas
nodes.description: Charge GAS_LOG constant as base cost

nodes.label: Calculate Data Gas Cost
nodes.description: Calculate GAS_LOG_DATA * size (per byte of log data)

nodes.label: Charge Data Gas
nodes.description: Deduct data gas cost from remaining gas

nodes.label: Calculate Topic Gas Cost
nodes.description: Calculate GAS_LOG_TOPIC * num_topics

nodes.label: Charge Topic Gas
nodes.description: Deduct topic gas cost from remaining gas

nodes.label: Calculate Memory Expansion Cost
nodes.description: Calculate gas for memory expansion if log data extends beyond current memory

nodes.label: Charge Memory Expansion Gas
nodes.description: Deduct memory expansion cost from remaining gas

nodes.label: LOG Gas Fully Charged
nodes.description: All gas components deducted successfully

nodes.label: Out of Gas During LOG
nodes.description: Insufficient gas for LOG operation

sub_graphs.title: Cancun LOG Instructions: Static Context Security Check
sub_graphs.description: Models the security check preventing LOG in static contexts

nodes.label: LOG Instruction Requested
nodes.description: LOG opcode about to execute

nodes.label: Check Static Context Flag
nodes.description: Verify if current execution is within a static call context

nodes.label: Executing in Static Context
nodes.description: Current call is STATICCALL - state modifications prohibited

nodes.label: Not in Static Context
nodes.description: Current call allows state modifications

nodes.label: Raise WriteInStaticContext Exception
nodes.description: Throw exception for attempting LOG in static context

nodes.label: LOG Execution Reverted
nodes.description: LOG operation rejected, call will revert

nodes.label: LOG Execution Allowed
nodes.description: LOG operation permitted, proceed with execution

ambiguities.text: The documentation does not specify behavior when memory_start_index + size overflows uint256
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume memory expansion calculation handles overflow by treating the required memory size as extremely large, causing out-of-gas. Follow standard EVM memory expansion rules.

ambiguities.text: The relationship between partial function application for LOG0-LOG4 and the generic log_n is described but topic handling order is implicit
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume topics are popped in order from stack (first topic is stack[2], second is stack[3], etc.) after memory_start and size.

implicit_assumptions.description: Memory is automatically expanded when reading beyond current memory bounds for log data
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Out-of-bounds memory access could cause undefined behavior or security vulnerabilities

implicit_assumptions.description: LOG operations are atomic - either the entire log entry is recorded or the operation reverts completely
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Partial log entries could corrupt event data, affecting off-chain systems relying on logs

implicit_assumptions.description: The contract address recorded in log entries is the actual executing contract's address
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Log spoofing could allow contracts to emit events appearing to be from other contracts

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot manipulate the static context flag through malicious bytecode
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Could bypass static context protection and emit logs during STATICCALL
